messages:
Ethan K.: Heads-up — nightly docs linker found 8 404s across /docs/getting-started and /docs/integ. Running a quick triage.
Maya S.: thanks. can you paste the list? even shortlinks are fine.
Ethan K.: short list: /docs/getting-started/api.md#rate-limits, /docs/integ/aws-private.md (old shortlink), /docs/ops/runbooks/release.md#rollback, /assets/diagrams/auth-flow-old.svg -> 403, /docs/cli/installation.md#windows (broken anchor)
Priya N.: I can take the getting-started anchors + run a local `link-checker` pass. Which branch should I PR against? main or docs/patch-2?
Ethan K.: please target docs/patch-2 — we want a minor dot release with these.
Liam D.: I'll handle the AWS onboarding shortlink swap — will add a test that shortlinks resolve to canonical path.
Docs Bot: Link scanner triggered by commit 9a1c2d 12 report: https://scans.internal/6999990001
Maya S.: small ask: include a one-line entry in CHANGELOG under 0.12.3 about link fixes. Keeps release notes tidy.
Priya N.: noted. I'll include CHANGELOG and smoke test steps in PR template. Example smoke tests:
    - run `yarn docs:serve`
    - open /getting-started and verify anchor links
    - run `npm run link-check`
Liam D.: pinging @docs-review to prioritize review 12 these are low-risk but need fast merge.
Ethan K.: also added a note to the routing team: if we replace old shortlinks create redirects (CloudFront) so external bookmarks don't 404.
Docs Bot: Reminder set by Maya S. for 2024-02-06 10:00 UTC to verify redirects
Maya S.: Thanks all. If you're batching edits, tag the file globs here. I'll do a final pass post-merge and trigger the docs CI deployment.
Priya N.: PR 55001 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/55001 12 includes anchor fixes + CHANGELOG. cc @Maya S.
Liam D.: PR 55002 for shortlink swaps opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/55002 12 added unit test and redirect follow-up ticket https://tickets.internal/RED-789
Ethan K.: Great. When both merged I'll run the full link-scan and close the ticket.
Maya S.: perfect. Thanks team :rocket:
